image_description: The image displays two black grouse (blackcocks) in a dry, grassy field. The bird on the right is standing in profile, showcasing its glossy black plumage, red eyebrow comb, and white undertail coverts. The bird on the left is partially visible, showing similar black plumage and a large white patch on its rear/tail area. The background consists of blurred brown vegetation.
